privacy.title: Privacy & advertising notice
privacy.intro: Privacy and advertising notes for this static travel guide at korea-guidebook.cloud.
privacy.privacyLead: This is a static Korea travel guide (korea-guidebook.cloud). No sign-up or login is needed to browse.
privacy.privacyLi1: We do not run a visitor account system.
privacy.privacyLi2: If you send feedback via LINE or email, we use only what you voluntarily send—to reply or fix errors.
privacy.privacyLi3: Third-party ads such as Google AdSense may set cookies or collect usage data. See Google’s advertising policies for details.
privacy.privacyContact: For privacy questions, use the same Contact & Feedback channel on the home page. LINE ID hwangsang95 / email zxc1063@naver.com
privacy.adsLi1: This site may show Google ads.
privacy.adsLi2: Whether ads are personalized depends on Google and your settings.
privacy.adsLi3: You can manage ad settings in Google Ads Settings.
privacy.adsLi4: Ads are labeled and are not an endorsement of any product or service.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: We made this site so visitors to Korea can travel a little more easily and usefully. It's free to use—feedback for improvements is always welcome. Whether you're planning a trip or already here, we hope you have a wonderful time.
welcome.bodyShare: Food and tips on this site will not be based only on random web info—we'll prioritize places that people who actually visited said were good. If you have great experiences or restaurant recommendations from your Korea trip, please check the inquiry/feedback section at the bottom of the main page. You can share tips or find contact details there, and we'll review them for the guide.
